doc_title: TRANSFER OF LAND BY A TRUSTEE
doc_title_official: TRANSFER OF LAND BY A TRUSTEE
when_used: A trustee registered as proprietor transfers the right title and interest held on trust to a transferee.

body_text.text: The Transferor HEREBY TRANSFERS to the Transferee the Transferor(s) right title and interest in the above Title.
The Transfer is subject to the following:
The provisions of The Land Registration Act (No 3 of 2012) and The Land Act(No 6 of 2012);
The interests noted in the Register of the Title.
The Transfer is also subject to the following additional provisions, if any:
The Transferee(s) shall hold the land comprised in the Title as joint proprietors/as proprietors in common*** in the following undivided shares:-
IN WITNESS WHEREOF the Transferor and the Transferee have signed this Transfer as a deed.

foot_notes: Insert full name(s) registration number(s) registered office and address, as applicable.
Insert currency, amount and other consideration where applicable.
****The person attesting the signature must authenticate the coloured passport size photograph, National ID Number and Tax PIN Number.”
